items.excerpt: Patrice Desilets says Panache pulled every gen-AI asset from the 1666: Amsterdam prologue and will ship none in Early Access, admitting the team stopped noticing AI art in its own pipeline: 'we didn't even realize it was AI anymore because we were used to seeing it.' He defends the tool as a variation engine a 'small team' can't staff for — 75 versions in three seconds versus 75 illustrators.

Hello Games' Sean Murray — whose studio literally shipped the poster child for procedural generation — says he is in no hurry to fold generative AI into No Man's Sky's production, comparing the industry-wide AI race to post-COVID return-to-office mandates. His pitch: 'let's just enjoy making games the way we've always made games.'

Fenris Creations (EVE Online / EVE Frontier) has named Aslaug Arna Sigurbjornsdottir senior director of AI partnerships to push autonomous-agent work. The design hook: the studio wants EVE Frontier used as a live testbed where 'autonomous agents can be observed in a real, open and evolving economy, alongside real people.'

Game Science co-founder and art director Yang Qi says the Black Myth: Zhong Kui team is deliberately keeping generative AI out of design and asset production, preferring its own hand methods. He frames it as timing rather than ideology — the studio isn't opposed to the tech, it just refuses to rush into it mid-production.

Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick tells investors that AI tooling inside the GTA 6 publisher's studios is additive rather than substitutive — 'AI tools aren't going to replace anyone.' It's the clearest statement yet from a top-tier publisher on where it draws the line between AI-assisted production and headcount.

An indie dev found Google's AI surfacing very specific unannounced details about their Steam game — content plans they say lived only in private Google Docs and were never posted anywhere. A live warning about what studio-side AI assistants can quietly ingest from a team's own production docs.

Megumi Ogata, the voice of Shinji in Evangelion, calls AI voice cloning 'heartbreaking' and asks the Japanese government to step in. The push lands as synthetic-voice pipelines spread through game and anime production and Japan still lacks the AI consent terms SAG-AFTRA won in the US.

Fans flagged a Kingdom Hearts illustration as gen-AI because of a botched hand; Square Enix says it was ordinary human error — someone miscounted Donald's fingers. A small but telling case of AI suspicion now shaping how players read every piece of official key art.

notes.verification: Every published_iso was read from the article itself (og article:published_time, JSON-LD datePublished, or the outlet's own RSS pubDate for GameSpot, which blocks direct fetches) and then gated with `python3 pipeline/freshness.py <published> 2026-08-10T22:01:00Z games`. All 12 printed FRESH. Nothing was accepted on a search-snippet date.
notes.blocked_domains: gamesindustry.biz, ign.com, polygon.com, eurogamer.net, rockpapershotgun.com and vg247.com are all refused by the search user agent, which removed six of the section's allowed_domains from the funnel. gamespot.com, venturebeat.com and thegamer.com block WebFetch/curl on article pages; GameSpot was recovered via its own news RSS, the others were dropped rather than guessed.
notes.per_source_cap: Kotaku 3, GamesRadar+ 2, all others 1. 9 distinct outlets: GamesRadar+, Kotaku, Game Developer, GamingBolt, GameSpot, NVIDIA Blog, PC Gamer, Aftermath, 80 Level.
notes.dropped_stale: The engine-tooling emphasis largely failed on freshness: the whole Unreal Engine 6 / State of Unreal gen-AI cluster (wccftech, Kotaku, Aftermath, 80.lv, Game Developer) is mid-June; NVIDIA's ACE Game Agent SDK + UE5 plugins is 2026-06-16; the Steam / Valve AI-disclosure cluster is January; Unity Muse and Unity AI beta coverage is May or older; Inworld's Unreal AI Runtime SDK is 2025-10-29; the 1666: Amsterdam first-apology wave is June; Roblox Build / 4D generation is 2026-07-16. All confirmed by fetching real timestamps, then dropped.
notes.dropped_offtopic: Per the relevance test I dropped Unity's ad-platform quarter, the Unity/Supersonic sale, the EA CEO pay package, EVE-adjacent AI-industry finance, and PC Gamer's AI tag which in this window is almost entirely data-center, memory-pricing and OpenAI-lawsuit noise with no design hook.
notes.dropped_recent_dupes: Destructoid's 2026-08-08 piece on Google's QA-playing AI is the same Square Enix x Gemini story already published on 08-09; the Kotaku 2026-07-30 'The Relic: First Guardian' AI piece and the Shift Up / Stellar Blade AI-video items are also on the 08-09/08-10 skip list. notes.coverage: Queries run across the full plan: Unreal/Epic tooling, Unity AI, AI level design + PCG, AI game design tools, AI character creation, AI mod/UGC + Roblox, AI localization, AI voice acting + SAG-AFTRA, text-to-game, Genie / world models, AI playable worlds, Inworld, NVIDIA ACE, AI game art disclosure, gamescom 2026, Korean-language 'AI 게임 개발', plus YouTube. Social yielded nothing verifiable: the only AI-NPC/Unreal videos surfacing are 2023-era, and games defines no instagram_handles, so social contributes zero this run.
